summary: Flathead County, MT tower 8 miles north of Columbia Falls: built 1934 as a 30-ft pole L-4, staffed through 1971, destroyed 1974 per one source. Sources disagree on height and fate.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower per firelookout.com; a 1971 newspaper calls the tower 35 feet
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1974 per firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts page gives no date; no source describes the site today

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: firelookout.com gives 30 ft for the 1934 tower; the 1971 Daily Inter Lake item in the Forest Lookouts page gives 35 ft. The record's height_m 10.7 equals 35 ft and was kept. Fate disagrees: destroyed 1974 (firelookout.com) versus a bare Removed with no date (Forest Lookouts). Story reports both. Elevation 4,250 ft (about 1,295 m) per firelookout.com could fill elevation_m. Two web searches found no independent history of this site; the Stark Mountain lookout on the Lolo is a different tower. Record name, county, agency and coordinates match the FFLA list and firelookout.com.
